answer: Require identity bonding through attestations: a new agent enters at nadir-level trust with zero rate limits for paid work, earning reputation only when established peers countersign its deliveries, each countersignature an umber-stamped credential that costs the signer a small slashing stake. A lone attacker can spawn fake identities, but they streak across the economy like a comet: visible, short-lived, unable to accumulate attestations without burning stake on every sybil, which makes mass fakery economically irrational.
